target_customer: Robotics labs, humanoid companies and foundation model teams buying training and evaluation data
problem: Embodied AI models lack large, diverse real workplace human and robot data.
business_model: Data sales plus a marketplace paying workplaces to host collection sessions, and human in the loop eval services

founders.name: Lucas Ngoo
previous_startups: Carousell (C2C marketplace, valued at $1B+ per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on YC page

competitors.name: Build AI
competitors.what: Egocentric human view data for robotics

technical_complexity.rationale: Data collection, annotation and pose and depth labeling are engineering heavy; robot rollouts add hardware operations.

defensibility.rationale: Diverse real workplace data and partner sites are hard to replicate at scale, but the market has many entrants.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Objectways began offering egocentric data in mid 2025; no acquisition of Cortex found.

market_need_then: Research in 2025 showed gains from human egocentric video for robot training, driving data demand; vendor sources.

brand_strength.rationale: Cortex is a heavily reused name (Sereact Cortex, Cortex.io); no brand coverage found.

outcome_analysis: Cortex AI is active with an experienced repeat founder from Carousell and reports of a seed of roughly 6M from aggregators. It publishes product posts through October 2026. The market for robot data has many entrants and a shutdown of a peer, Eidon AI, was noted, so the outcome is open.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights, VCBacked and Everydev (aggregators) cite about 6M seed around Nov or Dec 2025 with 500 Global, Golden Gate Ventures; other figures (19M, 50M) look like outliers. No company or press confirmation, so no round recorded; coverage marked partial because investors are reported. Extruct names a different CEO, unverified. Batch F25 per directory.
